虽然一些人认为，生物增强的个体确实更强壮、更健康，但另一些人则认为，这种心态对那些不愿或无法改变基因组以追求基因完美的人造成了不当的歧视。
texts.en:
Arbitrary purity tests are becoming commonplace in some industries. Those deemed to have superior genetic makeup are receiving preferential treatment in work, education, and blindly granted easier access to positions of power.

While some argue that individuals with bio-enhancements are indeed stronger and healthier, others contend that this mindset creates undue discrimination for those unwilling or unable to alter their genomes in the pursuit of genetic perfection.

label.en: We must ensure equal opportunities for all.
This is survival of the fittest.
